description:
Thanks to Enshrouded for sponsoring this video. Enshrouded 1.0 is available now on PC and PS5 with support for 16 players, upgraded graphics and performance boosts. Enjoy the full story, an entirely new biome, upgraded combat systems along with Sparkworks customisation. Find out more: https://connect.enshrouded.com/DF 

In the new AI era, it seems that decompilation, recompilation and unofficial ports are child's play - so what are the chances of an unofficial GTA 6 PC port before Rockstar delivers the real thing? And adjacent to that, how is Sony going to react to the massive impact of the recent PS5 jailbreak? Meanwhile, the panel are asked about the importance of PS5 Pro as it nears its second anniversary and questions are asked about the support level for the recently released QSSR.
